purpose: Teach: キャノン/イージス/トラップ/チルドレン/ブーイング/ミラクル/スリリング/フィニッシュ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、キャノンのカメラを愛用されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer loves using Canon cameras — did you notice?
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Thinking out loud as she speaks. Gentle pauses between clauses, like she's placing each observation carefully. No urgency.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、イージス艦の写真集を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, she was reading through this whole photography book about naval destroyers.
lines.style: Warm recognition in the voice. Slight smile underneath. Remembering a detail that made sense in the moment. Conversational, not performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、子供向けトラップゲームを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she was explaining this puzzle game to us — something kids are really into right now.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity in the delivery. Soft emphasis on 'explaining' — she found it charming that the customer wanted to share. Easy rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サマースクールのチルドレン向けプログラムをされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She mentioned she runs a summer program for children at the community center.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. A detail that clicked into place. Warm acknowledgment without making it a big thing. Observant but not intrusive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スタジアムのブーイングのお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She told us this intense story about the crowd booing at a stadium match.
lines.style: Slight lift in energy — the story caught her attention. Vivid but still grounded. Pausing briefly to let the moment breathe before moving on.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ミラクルな再会の体験を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She shared something about this amazing, almost unbelievable reunion she witnessed.
lines.style: Wonder in the voice, but tender — not overdone. Slower pace on 'amazing.' The kind of tone you use for something that made you believe in small miracles.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スリリングなスポーツ観戦のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was talking about this thrilling sports match she'd gone to recently.
lines.style: Slight warmth as she recalls the customer's excitement. The energy of the story comes through, but filtered through Mei's own gentle observation. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マラソンのフィニッシュ瞬間のお写真をお見せ下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she actually showed us a photograph — the exact moment she crossed the marathon finish line.
lines.style: Tender admiration in the delivery. Slight wonder at the precision of the image. Quieter on the ending, like she's still holding the moment gently. Trailing soft.
